title: I used AI to code my game, and I think it did a great job for the task
author: LovHatAds_com
selftext:
I'm not a coder, but I do have some understanding of coding. As a hobbyist. I always wanted to create some mobile game(s), but coding them has kept me from making any.

Several months ago, I've decided to try coding with AI, and I was in for a nice surprise: in a couple of months I've published my first mobile app (not a game) on both mobile platforms, then after another couple of months my first mobile game also on both mobile platforms. It's not a very visual with a lot of fast action game, but a novel text-based game - like an SMS app, all the "action" happens there. 

I am still trying to figure out how can I get AI to write a better prose, but so far it was fine with writing the prose together. I could use some feedback on how much looking as an AI coded app my game is and how can I make it looking less like an AI coded one, and also some tips about how can I get AI to use less AI specific words and phrases and more human like ones, because as of now I still have to write and correct a lot of the prose myself...

Here's the link (game is free, ad supported), for who wants to have a look and help give some hints: [https://lovhatads.com/negotiator/](https://lovhatads.com/negotiator/)
